title: Lavender Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar - 16-Inch Wall Mount Tempered Glass Vanity Shelf With Solid Brass Hardware - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Lavender, clear clutter on your vanity while keeping a towel right where you need it—this wall-mounted glass shelf adds storage and an integrated towel bar in one, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, it’s crafted with tempered glass and solid brass hardware for enduring bathroom performance.

  • Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose a look that complements transitional bath accessories and traditional spaces alike
  • Invest in solid brass hardware that outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection

Specs

  • Product type: Glass vanity shelf with integrated towel bar
  • Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
  • Glass thickness: 3/8 in (0.38 in)
  • Material: Tempered, beveled-edge glass; brass hardware
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
meta_description: 16-inch glass shelf with integrated towel bar for bathroom vanities. Wall-mounted tempered beveled glass with brass hardware. Limited lifetime warranty.
